items.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998
items.q: Finegan, something that Bob Merrill wrote, he’s the guy that wrote “Take Me Along” for Jackie Gleason, because he was a pop composer.

ctx.x: There was one number we did, the A & R man came on and he says, “Okay, let’s do another one.” Finegan says, “No, we’re not doing another one.” He says, “Why not?” He says, “The guys in the band don’t want to do another one, they like that one.” He says, “There’s a couple of mistakes.” Finegan says, “The hell with the mistakes, the feel was there.” And of course we had our revenge. RCA wanted us to do something with kazoos because that was the rage. So Finegan, something that Bob Merrill wrote, he’s the guy that…
